BOOK_A.title: Defendant's Options
BOOK_A.commentary: This Rule makes it clear that adefendant can move to strike the statement of claim before filing a defence. *Statement of Defence*
BOOK_A.footnotes_note: not split out: this extraction prints footnotes as unmarked text inside the page (see commentary); nothing was dropped
BOOK_A.operative_text_note: same wording as official 3.30 lead-in and (a)-(c) (read by eye) except the bracket labels '[Setting aside service]' after 'rule 11.31' and '[Court options to deal with significant deficiencies]' after 'rule 3.68' (both match the official titles of 11.31 and 3.68), the title in title case ('Defendant's Options', straight apostrophe), missing spaces and '*' line marks, and the footnote marker '1' printed between (b) and (c). No amendment bracket; the official text lists only 'AR 124/2010' (no amending regulation). No substantive difference. The Subdivision 3 heading printed before the title ('Subdivision 3 Defence to Statement of Claim, Reply to Defence and Demand for Notice', p.3-80 lines 2176-2178) matches the official Subdivision 3 heading. This rule's history footnote 1 ('Quite similar to previous 1968 R.27. It came from 1944 C.R.29, and Eng.1883 O.12 r.30') and footnote 2 ('McMeekin v. A.-G. Alta. 2012 ABQB 144, 537 AR 136') are printed at p.3-80 (line 2175) inside the built 3.29 record and are kept there.
BOOK_A.commentary_review_flag: Read in full, p.3-80 (line 2178) to line 2183: rule text, Information Note, Defined Terms 'Court, defendant, file, order' (the Appendix defines each), Related Provisions '3.34 (demand for notice)' (official 3.34 is 'Demand for notice by defendant') and a one-sentence note. The built record holds the information note (Book A only), defined_terms, related_provisions and the commentary field (130 characters: the note, then the title of 3.31 'Statement of Defence'). (1) Information Note: 'The rule relating to a demand for notice is rule 3.34 [Demand for notice by defendant]. In foreclosure actions a notice of address for service may be filed and served under rule 11.24 [Notice of address for service in foreclosure actions]' - both labels match the official titles of 3.34 and 11.24. (2) Note: 'This Rule makes it clear that a defendant can move to strike the statement of claim before filing a defence' agrees with 3.30(b) (an order under 3.68) and official 3.68(1)(a) ('that all or any part of a claim or defence be struck out'); footnote 2 (McMeekin v. A.-G. Alta. 2012 ABQB 144, 537 AR 136) is printed in the 3.29 record (which sentence it belongs to is not shown). (3) The history footnote 1 (1968 R.27; 1944 C.R.29; Eng. 1883 O.12 r.30) is in the 3.29 record (its marker '1' is printed between (b) and (c) in the 3.30 text). (4) No other rule's note in Book A cites 3.30 by number (searched all combined*.txt files); Book C's 3.47 commentary and a Book C commentary in the 541-560 file cite it (see see_also).
